assessment: World/glyph/terminal continuation commands are ordered leading marker, actual staging copy command, trailing marker in one queue submission. Finish bookkeeping follows real submit. Final Main and dialog commands are leading marker, optional flush_frame_uploads command, final painter/resolve command; final uploads no longer fall before the first marker.

Timeline reserves final sixth submission and rejects missing preceding completion/source-target change/reversed attempt lineage.

Final transfer_end is first final painter query index immediately after leading marker pair. First/last submission markers and transfer interval index arithmetic correctly account for nested scene markers without including them in pass sums. Raw queries decode manifest before extraction; flattened passes exclude scene markers.

Every continuation holds slot query/resolve/readback plus marker through queue completion; final holds prior frame resource refs before validation. Drop aborts unfinished measurement. Host cancellation invalidates pending slots and submitted holds outlive host. New marker is tracked4bytes and independent of optional prefix eviction.
Final query resolve/readback copy is instrumentation after final rendering boundary. This is not physical device duty or presentation latency, and marker/pass sums are not transfer intervals.

Actual native frame/capture adapters set immutable session attempt/preparation/target metadata before encoding. Continuations may advance attempt/revision with unchanged preparation/target, accommodating deferred attempts; changed source/preparation cancels rather than merging GPU work silently.
